austria.label: Österreich
austria.summary: Über Wien wird der Fluglärm aktuell öffentlich diskutiert. Zudem plant Wien strengere Regelungen für Partys, was auf verschärfte Lärmschutzmaßnahmen im städtischen Bereich hindeutet.

items.title: Wie empfindet ihr den Fluglärm über Wien? - Der Standard
Nebel lauert am Morgen - Ruhige Nacht, aber kühl: Tiefstwerte bis 2 Grad - Kronen Zeitung

europe.label: Europa
europe.summary: Noise pollution is increasingly recognized as a significant health threat in Europe, with growing concern over its impacts on residents. Communities near major infrastructure, such as data centres in Slough, are raising alarms about noise-related health consequences, highlighting the need for stronger noise control measures.

items.title: Noise pollution poses a threat to health - Il Sole 24 ORE
Sleepless in Slough: the residents who fear for their failing health in Europe’s data centre capital - The Nerve

science.label: Wissenschaft
science.summary: Two new studies highlight the growing importance of acoustic environments on human wellbeing: one investigates how traffic speed and soundscapes influence perception and cognitive workload in virtual reality settings, while the other demonstrates that natural soundscaping interventions in noisy urban areas can meaningfully improve sleep quality in working adults on the same night of exposure.

items.title: Influence of traffic speed and acoustic environment on perception and perceived workload in virtual reality - Nature
The positive impact of naturally soundscaping a noisy urban space on same-night sleep in working adults - Nature
